title: 金价破纪录：矿企却把分红提到60%，并购北美澳洲的钱从哪来？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Record final dividend, so is this the plan going forward?
segments.zh: 创纪录的末期股息，这是未来的计划吗？

segments.en: Keep returning money to shareholders as these prices hold, and is that pay-up ratio something that could be tweaked down the track?
segments.zh: 随着价格保持，继续向股东返还资金，这个派息率未来会调整吗？

segments.en: Morning, Paul. Thank you for your time. Look, I mean, I think if you look at it and you were just talking about record gold prices and movements overnight, we had a record profit, record cash flows,
segments.zh: 早上好，保罗。感谢您的时间。我认为，如果您看看，您刚才提到创纪录的金价和隔夜走势，我们实现了创纪录的利润和现金流，

segments.en: and moving to a net cash position during the year we knew we had to reward our shareholders and hence we lifted our pay-up rate from 50% to 60%,
segments.zh: 并且在年内转为净现金头寸，我们知道必须回报股东，因此将派息率从50%提高到60%，

segments.en: and given the moves overnight, if gold holds at those levels over the course of the year, then the cash flow generation we're going to have in FY27 will be a lot higher
segments.zh: 鉴于隔夜的走势，如果金价在年内保持这些水平，那么我们在2027财年将产生更高的现金流，

segments.en: and we'll continue to look at how we can give some of that back to shareholders.
segments.zh: 我们将继续研究如何将部分资金返还给股东。

segments.en: Yeah, this is a break with traditional approaches that we've seen in prior gold price rallies.
segments.zh: 是的，这与以往金价上涨时的传统做法不同。

segments.en: I mean, often companies have gone on a bit of an M&A spree. You've bought a copper project, Carnaby Resources in Queensland, and of course copper now in hot demand with the AI build out.
segments.zh: 通常，公司会进行并购热潮。您购买了昆士兰的Carnaby Resources铜项目，而随着人工智能的发展，铜现在需求旺盛。

segments.en: Do you see this growing in importance as a product for evolution?
segments.zh: 您认为这对Evolution来说会变得越来越重要吗？

segments.en: Yeah, certainly. I think if you look at the fundamentals of the copper industry at the moment, there's short-term supply issues, there's increasing demand,
segments.zh: 是的，当然。我认为，看看目前铜行业的基本面，存在短期供应问题，需求在增加，

segments.en: and that's what's seeing gold. Copper prices move up to record levels.
segments.zh: 这正是推动金价和铜价创下历史新高的原因。
